_comment: Four files in this pack all target minecraft:skeleton. They POOL: each skeleton sticky-picks exactly one of the files whose conditions it satisfies, weighted by pool_weight, and remembers that choice. Spell lists are never merged.

conditions._comment: A biome entry may be a plain biome id or a #tag. Dimensions are plain ids only - biome tags work here, dimension tags do not.

spells._comment: root reads a target entity during a channelled cast, so it must be role attack - a support role has no target and the spell would be skipped.
